title: Grateful Dead Live at William and Mary College Hall on 1973-09-11
lineage: aud>?>7" reel @ 3.75 ips, no nr technics rs-1506>hd-p2 24/96>cd wave>adobe audition 2.0>flac; patched/seeded by Rob Berger 2011-03-03

ai_review.summary: Legendary setlist but hampered by a half‑step low pitch and tape glitches; soundboard source with poor recording quality.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the rarity and desirability of the show’s setlist, saying most fans would die for this performance. Unfortunately the recording suffers from a noticeable pitch drop (about a half‑step), especially on the first set, along with nasty tape stops and cuts that detract from listening enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised as exceptional while recording issues are severe; limited number of reviews reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Half‑step low pitch throughout (worse on first set), frequent tape machine stops and cuts, overall muddy and inconsistent sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Setlist described as awesome and highly coveted; no specific song commentary beyond overall enthusiasm.
